speed.note: fMRIPrep's call (-Fourier -twopass -zpad 4 with -1Dfile, -1Dmatrix_save, -maxdisp1D) on the parity suite's inputs, one thread each (3dvolreg has no parallel loop on this path), the median of three runs, reading and writing compressed NIfTI included, every output checked byte for byte; on the main machine while another agent worked: indications, not a benchmark report. The ratio is AFNI's time over the replica's program's. Tool: validation/investigations/afni-volreg/speed.py.

examples.title: fMRIPrep's registration of a real BOLD run's reference volumes
examples.summary: fMRIPrep's BOLD reference is the median of some of a run's volumes, aligned first: niworkflows' RobustAverage (the gen_avg node of fMRIPrep 25.2.6's hmc_boldref_wf) takes 20 volumes of OpenNeuro ds000005 sub-01's first run (file volumes 20 to 39 of 240), clips them and divides them by the global signal's drift, and gives them to 3dvolreg with -Fourier -twopass -zpad 4. That call, given to AFNI 26.3.05, AFNI 25.2.09, fMRIPrep's build of AFNI and the larmorx replica in both modes. Choose a volume with the slider; the input panels show the run before registration.

stats.title: The text outputs compared, over every volume (the files without their comment line)
stats.note: Values as the files write them (-1Dfile: 4 decimals; -maxdisp1D: 3). The shaded rows are AFNI against itself. AFNI-99: the maximum displacement AFNI writes is that of the voxel mirrored along every axis stored posterior to anterior (this run's second axis); the default computes it for the voxel itself, reproduce gives AFNI's numbers.

examples.metrics_note: Δ is A − B, computed in float64 over every value of the files (2,785,280), not only those shown; the range is B's maximum minus its minimum. The record's threshold: every output bit-identical to AFNI 26.3.05's (the registered series, -1Dfile, -1Dmatrix_save, -maxdisp1D), with its exit status and messages. The rows *the original against itself* are AFNI's own variability on this input: its previous release and fMRIPrep's build.

examples.title: AFNI-99: the maximum displacement of a mirrored voxel
examples.summary: 3dvolreg's -maxdisp1D (and -savedisp) convert the registration's rotation and shift to the dataset's axes with each axis's sign, but take the voxel positions without it: for an axis stored left to right, posterior to anterior or superior to inferior, the displacement computed is that of the voxel mirrored about the axis's centre. fMRIPrep's volumes of the first example are stored that way along their second axis. The same volumes stored with that axis reversed (LPS: every axis positive in AFNI's order), registered by AFNI 26.3.05 and the replica in both modes.

facts.label: Input
facts.text: the first example's sliced volumes; and the same stored integers, scale factor and header, the second axis reversed and the qform and sform changed so that every voxel stays where it was

facts.label: Defect
facts.text: [AFNI-99](repo:docs/api/afni-volreg.md#upstream-defects): -maxdisp and -savedisp give the displacements of a mirrored position; corrected by default, named; reproduce gives AFNI's numbers

facts.label: Size
facts.text: on this run, whose head moves little (at most 0.157 mm from the base), AFNI's maximum displacements change by up to 0.011 mm with the storage order; the error grows with the rotation and with the voxels' distance from the axis's centre (on the API page's synthetic series, 1.718 against 1.672 mm)

facts.label: fMRIPrep
facts.text: RobustAverage writes -maxdisp1D but uses only the registered volumes: fMRIPrep's results do not change
